breakdown.description: Smaller grains increase strength, but gives a negative Hall–Petch constant k_y. For normal Hall–Petch strengthening, k_y should be positive.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses k_y = +0.70 MPa·m^(1/2) (positive value) in its calculation, resulting in σ_y = 120 + 233 ≈ 353 MPa. It does not repeat the erroneous negative k_y value from the incomplete prompt, aligning with the ground truth.
